whyMe.title: What you can expect when we work together

items.title: No low-quality AI slop
items.desc: No generic automated generators or cheap template art. Every graphic element, subtitle animation, and cut is crafted by hand.

items.title: Asynchronous communication
items.desc: No endless Zoom calls. Concise Telegram updates, frame-accurate review links, and structured progress logs save hours of your time.

items.title: Long-term collaboration
items.desc: I immerse myself in your channel's unique voice. By the second video, turnarounds accelerate because I already understand your aesthetic.

items.title: Automated routine tasks
items.desc: I employ proprietary scripts for footage logging, audio levelling, and motion presets, giving all focus to narrative and visual craft.

items.q: How much do your services cost?
items.a: Pricing depends on duration, graphics complexity, and raw footage volume. A standard long-form edit starts from $200. Accurate quotes provided upon review.
Typical turnaround for a 10–15 minute video is 3 to 7 business days. An initial rough draft is delivered within 2–3 days.

items.q: How should I send you the footage?
items.a: Via any high-speed cloud platform: Google Drive, Dropbox, or Telegram. Large RAW archives are transferred using unthrottled direct links.

items.q: How many revisions are included in the price?
items.a: Two comprehensive rounds of timestamped revisions are included with every project, which is plenty since structure is locked early.

items.q: Do you work with international clients?
items.a: Yes, I work with creators and brands worldwide (US, Europe, Asia). Invoicing available in standard fiat or crypto (USDT/crypto transfers).
